home.sharedWaiting: Nobody has opened the link yet
home.sharedUntil: No time limit, until you get the car
home.stopBody: The link stops working and the person is told.

home.gotCarShared_other: The spot moves to History (its photo is kept for 3 days). {{count}} shares are closed and their recipients are told you got the car.
home.changeTitle: Share for how long from now?
home.gotCarDone: Done! The parking moved to History and your share links are closed.

share.sheetTitle: Share this spot for how long?
share.message: {{name}} shared a parking spot with you. Open the link to accept, see the photo, get directions and chat (expires in {{hours}}h): {{url}}
share.messageUntil: {{name}} shared a parking spot with you. Open the link to accept, see the photo, get directions and chat (shared until the car is picked up): {{url}}
share.orFriend: or send it straight to a friend
share.waitingBody: A link works for one person, and nobody has accepted yours yet. Send that same link again, or stop it below to create a new one.
share.sentLink: Link sent. It works for one person: the first to accept it gets the spot.
share.sentTo: Sent to {{name}}. They got a notification.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to share your parking spot, get notifications and chat with friends.
login.noAccount: Don't have an account? Sign up
login.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

account.title: Account
account.changePhoto: Tap the photo to change your avatar
account.signOutBody: You won't get message and sharing notifications until you sign in again.
account.phoneHint: Pick a country code (default +84). Only your friends can see this number, and people can find you with it.
account.discardBody: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
account.phoneInvalid: This isn’t a valid phone number for the selected country. Enter it without the country code.
account.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your profile, friends, shares, chats and photos from our servers, and your parkings and history from this phone. It cannot be undone.
account.deleted: Your account and its data were deleted.

history.title: History
history.empty: Nothing yet. History keeps your past parkings; photos are deleted after 3 days.
history.deleteBody: The conversation, photos and related notifications are deleted for everyone it was shared with too. This can't be undone.
history.signIn: Sign in to save and see your parking history. Without an account nothing is kept.
history.deletedDone: Deleted from History, and for everyone it was shared with.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.signIn: Sign in to get message and sharing notifications.
notifications.deleteBody: The selected notifications will be permanently deleted.

notify.bodyDays_other: Your car has been parked for {{count}} days. Expires {{date}} unless you extend.

friends.empty: No friends yet. Search by email or phone number.

friends.removed: {{name}} was removed from your friends, along with everything shared between you.
